description: Defines the TransactionCard widget for displaying transaction details within a Flutter app. It shows amount, category icon/name, note, and date, and includes logic for icon selection and category lookup.

classes.name: TransactionCard
classes.description: A stateless widget that displays transaction information in a card layout with icon, amount, note, and date.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the widget tree for the transaction card, displaying transaction details.

methods.name: _formatDate
methods.description: Formats a DateTime object into a 'YYYY-MM-DD' string.

methods.name: _two
methods.description: Pads single-digit numbers with a leading zero.

methods.name: _iconFromName
methods.description: Returns an IconData based on the category's icon name.
